# Test fixtures

## `api/` — recorded real API responses

Generated by `scripts/make_fixtures.py` from the raw layer of a live pipeline run (2026-11-16).
They are **real responses, trimmed** to keep the repository small:

| File | Source | Trimming / edits |
|---|---|---|
| `cisa_kev.json` | CISA KEV feed | 10 of the 1,781 entries kept; `count` set to 10 so the count check stays meaningful |
| `nvd_page.json` | NVD CVE API 2.0 pages | KEV and OSV-alias CVEs + 25 recent CVEs; references cut to 5, configurations to 2 × 4 CPE matches; `totalResults`/`resultsPerPage` set to the kept count |
| `osv_querybatch.json` | OSV querybatch | Only the 4 packages of `watchlist.yaml`, at most 8 advisories each |
| `osv_vulns.json` | OSV `/v1/vulns/{id}` | The advisories referenced above, unmodified |
| `epss.json` | FIRST EPSS API | Rows for the fixture CVEs, including 30-day `time-series` where it was recorded |

No value was invented. `cybersentinel/replay.py` serves these files to the pipeline in tests,
in the CI dbt job and in `python -m cybersentinel run --replay`.

## `contracts/` — Parquet servers for `datacontract test`

Validated tables written by a replay run (`data-replay/lake/validated/...`), one file per contract.

## `watchlist.yaml`

Four packages (log4j-core, spring-beans, Flask, express) used by the offline tests.
